Global (All).title: Tension escalates between US and Iran following military drills in the Persian Gulf.
Global (All).summary: Tensions in the Middle East escalated after US and Iranian militaries conducted separate training exercises in the Persian Gulf, prompting concerns about potential conflict.

Global (All).title: Russia-Ukraine Conflict: Putin warns of potential nuclear attack if West intervenes.
Global (All).summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin warned of the possibility of a nuclear response if Western nations intervene militarily in the conflict between Russia and Ukraine.

Global (All).title: Climate Change: Global temperatures set to rise by 3.2°C by 2100, report warns.
Global (All).summary: A new report predicts that global temperatures will rise by 3.2°C by 2100, highlighting the urgent need for climate action.

United States.title: Supreme Court overturns Roe v. Wade
United States.summary: The decision has sparked widespread protests and has significant implications on reproductive rights in the US.

United States.title: Congressman shoots attacker in self-defense
United States.summary: The incident highlights concerns over gun violence and congressional security.

United States.title: US inflation rate reaches 9.1% in June
United States.summary: The high inflation rate continues to affect Americans' purchasing power and economic stability.

South Korea.title: North Korea fires two ballistic missiles into the Sea of Japan
South Korea.summary: South Korea and Japan condemn the launches, which come amid heightened tensions on the Korean Peninsula.

South Korea.title: South Korean government to increase military spending to counter North Korea
South Korea.summary: The move aims to boost the country's military capabilities in response to the nuclear-armed North's growing threats.

Japan.title: Magnitude 6.0 earthquake strikes northern Japan, triggering landslides and power outages
Japan.summary: A magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck northern Japan on 13 August 2024, triggering landslides and power outages. The quake also caused widespread damage and disrupted transportation services.

Japan.title: Japan's defence minister visits US for talks on security cooperation
Japan.summary: Japan's defence minister arrived in the US on a three-day visit to discuss security cooperation and share expertise on defence technology.

Japan.title: Japan sees surge in COVID-19 cases as Omicron variant spreads
Japan.summary: Japan reported a surge in COVID-19 cases due to the spread of the Omicron variant, with new infections rising to 10,000 per day, according to health officials.
